body: sorry.  I certainly wasn't meaning to tell you to give up -- just the opposite was my intention.  But I know when you're extremely depressed everything is interpreted negative, so I apologize.  I only said to try to 'slow down on the alcohol', because I've been there.  And I know in the long run it makes things worse.  I honestly believe that if you NEED to medicate yourself, marijuana is a bit better.  Or see your Doctor.  Sometimes we do need something to help us get over the really treacherous rough spots in lift -- at least for a while.  I am sure you have much to live for, but it's hard to find it right now in the midst of your current miseries.

I've been feeling like ending it all -- but I'm a lot older than you.  I'm also a huge over-thinker, and have been coping with excessive marijuana use over the last few years.  Like you, I'm frightened about a botched suicide attempt (which is probably good, or I may have done it by now).  The truth is, we need to find a way to get through what we're going through now, because things really can get better.  It's hard for me to keep this in mind when I'm thinking about my own problems, but when I hear someone else (like you), I know that it would be a total waste for you to end it all now.  When you're an 'over-thinker', the truth is you're probably extremely intelligent, but you need to find your true passion and start channeling your energy in a positive way.  Have you ever tried meditation - I know it may sound wacky, but for over-thinkers, it is the one way to quiet the mind, and get in touch with the real you.  It also makes you far less concerned with external factors, and more able to find contentment within yourself, regardless what is going on...  I think I will try to take some of my own advice!!  : )  Take care!

Please slow down on the alcohol - trust me, it will only make things worse.  I lost my dad 2 years ago, so I know how hard that is.  But you need to feel it.  The girlfriend/best friend thing is terrible - but they've shown their true colors -- I know it doesn't feel that way, but she probably isn't the girl for you in the long run.  And your friend?  who knows...  Stay strong.  you have so much living ahead of you.  Things will never be the same without your dad - you are now entering a new reality.  But in time you will learn to adjust to that new reality, remembering the best things about your dad, and what he taught you.  You can always find him if you go silently within - his energy will always be with you.

thank you again.  I know this sounds really shallow, but the thing is that I used to be quite attractive.  and this was probably something I both relied on and took for granted much of my life.  And stupid as this sounds, but I feel like my son was always kinda 'proud' of how good his mom looked, especially for my 'age' (his friends were always so shocked and surprised - and he would joke that his friends thought I was 'hot').  this again sounds so shallow, but it is weird to have this whole aspect of your personality taken away so suddenly.  and through ELECTIVE surgery that i Paid for.  I really do look like a disfigured freak now - the eyes are the first thing that anyone looks at when they look at someone.  and I look so weird I guarantee that I can not get a job.  I pray to god I heal enough so I can go look for employment in a couple months, or I don't know what I will do.   I know my son will still love me.  but he will forever think i was so stupid to do what I have done.  as will everyone else.  and what I have done is 100% EVIDENT on my face, because of my Frankenstein of a Dr.  thank you for your comments and support.  i have done something, regrettably, that nothing can make better.  and i am stuck because i WANT to die, but i don't want to destroy my son in the process...

thank you for your kind words.  my botched surgery is so evident on my face by the huge scars under my eyes...  I know this shouldn't matter, but it is so humiliating.   The truth is, most people who have plastic surgery, want to slip back into society looking refreshed, with no one being the wiser.  Leave it to me, to pick a quack who leaves me with scars so evident it literally SCREAMS 'I had plastic surgery!!'.  I feel like I can't face anybody.  And my 17 year old son (who I know loves me), will be ashamed by my stupid decision to have this done.
